theme: OOP Ticket pool LISTOBJS/HASOBJ/DELETEOBJ + plate rehydrate

weaknesses.title: NEW object name is token ident, not string value of variable
weaknesses.detail: LET n='dyn'; NEW T n → object named 'n' not 'dyn'. Dynamic registries need fixed slot pools.
weaknesses.repro: LET n='dyn'; NEW T n; LISTOBJS has n not dyn

weaknesses.title: SETF string field from variable stores strlen not text
weaknesses.detail: SETF obj status st where st='open' → field becomes 4. Only string *literals* work. Blocks generic rehydrate.
weaknesses.repro: LET s='open'; SETF t status s; GETF → 4

weaknesses.title: NEW/METHOD string ctor args arrive as string length
weaknesses.detail: NEW Ticket t 'ticket-1' 3; GETF id → 8 (strlen). Must SETF literals after NEW.

weaknesses.title: Objects are process-local — no serialize; multi-run needs plate dual
weaknesses.detail: ARG-dispatch agents lose all NEW state each process. Board rehydrates from pool/*.txt.
weaknesses.repro: open in run1; has in run2 without plate → miss

weaknesses.title: DELETEOBJ unknown soft OK=0 sticky last_err
weaknesses.detail: Need CLEAR_ERR after soft destroy miss for -s.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: VAL/pool lines may glue in cat -A on short files.
